record.question: The main purpose of phase 1 clinical trial is:
options: To determine the efficacy of the drug
To determine the safety & tolerability of the drug
To determine the effect of the drug in chronic illness
To determine the therapeutic dose in special population
record.explanation: Answer B: To determine the safety & tolerability of the drug. Phase I trials primarily evaluate safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, and dose range in a small initial group. Reference: https://www.fda.gov/patients/drug-development-process/step-3-clinical-research. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
